title: Yoga Class
venue_name: Science of Spirituality International Meditation Center
description:
This yoga class is perfect for both novice and advanced practitioners.  Your instructor will guide you through a variety of postures to help you develop flexibility, strength, and balance.  

The class will conclude with meditation.  Bring a yoga mat and wear comfortable clothes.  Yoga is practiced without shoes and socks. Modest clothing please.

All are Welcome. Program is free of charge.
